HMS Royal Oak (08) — Revenge-class battleship, torpedoed by U-47 on 14 October 1939

notes: Built by code (model_sources/Q620472_hms_royal_oak.py, tools/meshkit.py, tools/dresskit.py) with AI assistance. Almost upside down at about 30-33 m in Scapa Bay, rolled over to starboard: the keel and bilges uppermost, the upperworks (turrets, tripod foremast, bridge, funnel) crushed into the bottom under her, the torpedo holes of U-47 in her starboard side amidships and at the bow, the four propellers and the rudder still in place, plating fallen about her. A war grave: diving is prohibited. The exact angle and heading (not published here: 0) are approximate. model_built.glb: the battleship as she was in 1939. No marine life in the model: Offlined draws the living things itself.
